Title: Poor Air Quality Days: 3 Habits That Backfire Indoors

Description:
Poor air quality outside doesn't mean you're safe once you're indoors - the EPA's wildfire smoke guidance actually flips a lot of the usual advice. Cracking the windows, cooking on the stove, and running the vacuum can all make indoor air worse on bad air days. Here's what to do instead: switch your HVAC to recirculate mode, hold off on frying and broiling, and run a properly sized HEPA air purifier.
